questions.stem_text: The global HIV/AIDS death rate is highest for which of these age groups?
questions.answer_explanation: The global HIV/AIDS death rate is highest for the 15-49 age group because this demographic encompasses the peak years of sexual activity and exposure to the virus, combined with factors such as limited access to healthcare and prevention resources in many regions.

questions.stem_text: Which of the following causes more deaths globally each year (as of 2017)?
